records.groupTitle: Average Marine Acidity (pH) Measured At Agreed Suite Of Representative Sampling Stations
records.title: Average Marine Acidity (pH) Measured At Agreed Suite Of Representative Sampling Stations, Annual
records.footnote: Data refer to the average marine acidity (pH) measured at agreed suite of representative sampling stations. Singapore's baseline pH levels ranged from 7.5 to 8.5. Data are used for SDG 14.3.1 'Average marine acidity (pH) measured at agreed suite of representative sampling stations'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 14.3.1.
